title: How to Use send_whatsapp_message
description: Send a WhatsApp text or reply within the 24h window; the account auto-resolves from the logged-in user. For new conversations outside 24h use a template.

title: How to Use send_whatsapp_template
description: Send an approved WhatsApp template to start a conversation outside the 24h window; find the template then pass body_parameters in order.
